newsitem.title: USA: Tubby's plans 75 new stores in Texas, move into Canada.
newsitem.headline: Tubby's plans 75 new stores in Texas, move into Canada.

text.p: Tubby's Inc., a speciality sandwich store chain, said Monday it plans to open 75 new outlets over the next five to 10 years in Texas, initially in the Dallas-Fort Worth area.
The first store is to open during the fall of this year.

The company also said it signed a development agreement with a sub-franchisor to expand the Tubby's Sub Shop concept into Canada for the first time. Under the agreement, 30 stores will be opened over the next five years in the provinces of Alberta and British Columbia.
The first store will open next month in Edmonton, followed by stores in Calgary and Vancouver.

Tubby's, based in Sterling Heights, Mich., has stores in Michigan, Ohio, Arizona and Pennsylvania. Tubby's is also the parent company for the casual dining-themed Stuff Yer Face restaurants, which have locations in New Jersey.
Tubby's stock edged down 1.6 cents to 31.25 cents on Nasdaq in late morning trading.
